name: toggle-29
description: Compare toggles on product rows feed a tray that enables comparison at two or more.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { GitCompareIcon, LaptopIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Toggle } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle" const laptops = [ { id: "air", name: "Nimbus Air 13", price: "$999" }, { id: "pro", name: "Nimbus Pro 14", price: "$1,599" }, { id: "max", name: "Nimbus Max 16", price: "$2,399" }, ] export default function ProductCompareToggle() { const [compare, setCompare] = React.useState([]) return (
{laptops.map((l) => (

{l.name}

{l.price}

setCompare((prev) => on ? [...prev, l.id] : prev.filter((x) => x !== l.id) ) } > Compare
))}
{compare.length} selected
) }
